why: The egress gate's state (mode, person-named hosts, once-per-host log set) is read by EgressURLProtocol.canInit(with:), a class method URLSession's loader calls on a URLProtocol subclass the system instantiates itself, and by URLProtocol.registerClass for URLSession.shared: there is no init to inject into. The Rust twin (cmux-tui/crates/cmux-egress) is process-wide for the same reason. It is one lock (OSAllocatedUnfairLock on Apple platforms, Synchronization.Mutex on Linux), counted once per #if branch.
